body.intent: Fix The plan workflow ends a run on a CI flake: its pr-green and rebased-green steps fail the run as soon as a check is red, with no rerun. Evidence: nebari plan run 01M6VY5APJP9 (PR #78) passed review, gate, pr-green and one rebase, then rebased-green failed at 18230d2 on 'test (4/5); failing tests: rspec ./spec/system/garden_location_spec.rb[1:1:11]', a spec that fails at random and passes on rerun (nebari runs 42427557598, 42427449690). Unstuck by gh run rerun --failed plus rhiza run resume --retry. A plan PR changes only .rhiza/, so a red app test can't be its fault: on red, the plan workflow should rerun the failed jobs once (budgeted) and only then fail, naming the test as unrelated to the plan. Ship-change has ci-triage for this (#350); plan has none.
